# Fast Eviction Service

> > California eviction and property management resource specializing in AB 1482 compliance, unlawful detainer procedures, and landlord-tenant law guidance.

Fast Eviction Service provides comprehensive resources for California landlords navigating eviction processes, tenant screening, lease agreements, and compliance with state laws including AB 1482 (California Tenant Protection Act), AB 2747 (rent reporting), and AB 2801 (security deposit documentation). The site offers legal forms, educational content, and practical guidance for property management in California's complex regulatory environment.

## Key Topics

- California eviction process
- AB 1482 (California Tenant Protection Act)
- Unlawful detainer procedures
- 3-day notice to pay or quit
- AB 2747 (rent reporting requirements)
- AB 2801 (security deposit photo documentation)
- Tenant screening and income verification
- Lease agreement clauses
- No-fault eviction protections
- Guest-to-tenant transitions
- Los Angeles County rental regulations
- Adverse possession and squatter rights
- COVID-19 rent relief programs
- Property management best practices
- California landlord-tenant law

- [How Much Does It Cost To Evict Someone](https://www.fastevictionservice.com/the-eviction-process-in-california/how-much-does-it-cost-to-evict-someone): California eviction costs breakdown including fees and legal expenses
- [Los Angeles County No Fault Eviction Protections](https://www.fastevictionservice.com/blog/los-angeles-county-no-fault-eviction-protections): Los Angeles County no-fault eviction rules and COVID-19 protections
